title: Time bound for function composition on an image
statement: Let $M$ and $U$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $f,g$ be functions from Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $T_1,T_2$ be functions from natural numbers to natural numbers. Suppose $M$ computes $f(x)$ on every input $x$ in exactly $T_1(|x|)$ steps, and suppose $U$ computes $g(x)$ from input $f(x)$ in exactly $T_2(|x|)$ steps for every Boolean word $x$. Then the buffered sequential composition of $M$ and $U$ computes $g$ on every input in exactly $2T_1(n)+T_2(n)+2$ steps when the input has length $n$.
